notes_for_editor: Built and destroyed dates agree across all sources. The only description of the site is a June 2006 SummitPost photo caption, which says only remnants are left and does not say what they are. The page title 'Old Lookout Foundation' is a title, not a description, so the story no longer calls the remains a foundation. Nothing newer was found. Coordinates conflict: the FFLA list gives 45.52801, -116.17389 and the brief also gives Idaho Fire Lookouts 45.53267, -116.17458; that page's text in the crawl shows no coordinates, so the list value is kept and this is unresolved. The 1915 lookout station and the 1927 cabin may not be the same structure; the sources do not say where the 1915 station stood. Access level 'public' was removed: no source states an access rule, and the level was only inferred from the drive-up tag and forest-road route. The editor may restore it if an access rule is found.
